entries.title: Bundled Postgres role
entries.content: Bundled Postgres role. supervisor role `postgres`: `initdb` on first run (scram, random password in `keys/`), `pg_ctl` start/stop with the supervisor, loopback-only on a private port (default 54329) + unix socket in the data dir, health check, `MAKTABA_DATABASE_URL` for every child, nightly `pg_dump` into `backups/` (keep 7), clean shutdown before exit. Postgres becomes the default home DB on macOS (TV slots on).

entries.title: Mac paths
entries.content: Mac paths. `config.Path()` / data dir / logs on macOS → `~/Library/Application Support/Maktaba` and `~/Library/Logs/Maktaba` (XDG kept on Linux; an existing XDG install is migrated once). Chroma dir, models dir, keys, streaming cache all set by `ChildEnv`.

entries.title: Pipeline in the bundle
entries.content: Pipeline in the bundle. `MAKTABA_PYTHON` → bundled Python; first-run venv bootstrap (`python -m venv` + `pip install --constraint` from the wheel, extras `stt,search` on arm64), progress reported to the supervisor/UI, resumable, re-run when constraints change.

entries.title: Transcription the way the home runs it
entries.content: Transcription the way the home runs it. supervisor runs a main worker `--exclude-stages transcribe` + N transcribe-only workers (`MAKTABA_STT_SLOT`), N and the STT memory knobs sized from RAM (the 96 GB Mac's stack.sh values as the top tier); `[transcription]` wired to `MAKTABA_STT_MODEL` / `MAKTABA_STT_REFINE*`; `maktaba-server models` downloads exactly what the pipeline loads (turbo + Cohere second listen, or Cohere from the NAS share).

entries.title: Login item + menu bar
entries.content: Login item + menu bar. Tauri shell: register/unregister the LaunchAgent via `SMAppService`; menu-bar status (running / starting / stopped / update ready) from the supervisor's `/processes`; Open Maktaba, Pause/Resume server, Open logs, Quit (window only) vs Stop server.

entries.title: First-run setup in the app
entries.content: First-run setup in the app. screens: what will run + disk/RAM check → admin account → library folder(s) / NAS path map → models (Hugging Face sign-in for the gated Cohere model, or use the NAS copy) → optional Plex sign-in → done (opens the library). Backed by `maktaba-server setup --json` steps so the CLI and the app share one implementation.

entries.title: Build the payload
entries.content: Build the payload. CI (desktop-release, macOS arm64): build the Go binaries (`embed_web`), fetch pinned Postgres, ffmpeg and python-build-standalone with checksums, build the pipeline wheel + constraints, lay out `Resources/server`, codesign every Mach-O inside, notarize the `.dmg`. A local `make mac-app` does the same unsigned.

entries.title: Updates
entries.content: Updates. the Tauri updater replaces the whole app (shell + server payload); on next start the supervisor migrates the DB (backup first, as today), rebuilds the venv only if constraints changed, restarts the roles. The launcher's own self-update is off inside the app (one updater).

entries.title: Move the home Mac in
entries.content: Move the home Mac in. `maktaba-server migrate-from-dev`: stop stack.sh services, `pg_dump` the Docker Postgres → restore into the bundled one, copy `~/.maktaba/{chroma,stream-signing.key,…}` and HF models, carry `MAKTABA_PATH_MAP` and the STT settings into `server.toml`, verify (library count, transcripts, Live TV host check-in), then retire Docker Postgres. Reversible (the Docker volume is kept until confirmed).
